## Details

<a id="game_init"></a>
### [`game_init`](../../../../src/init/game_init.asm#L6) `$81FF`

*label*

Game init after the cold start. Builds the screen row tables, initialises the high-score table (JSR $9dcc) and installs the interrupts. Sets the SID envelopes. Sets player 1 ($1c), lender 1 for both players ($4f01, $4f11), joystick port 1 ($1d) and music on ($5f = 0). Then starts the attract sequence at $9fa0.

- **Jumped to from:** [`cold_start`](cold_start.md#cold_start)
